title: Ecava IntegraXor Guest Acccount Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Ecava IntegraXor. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the "guest" user. The issue lies in the ability the retrieve all project credentials. By abusing this flaw an attacker can disclose credentials and leverage this situation to achieve remote code execution.
